# Command reference

Every command is available as `hermes mockreview <command>`. Without the Hermes plugin loader, `bin/mockreview <command>` in a checkout runs the same code. Commands print JSON unless noted. The text below is the real `--help` output.

## `hermes mockreview --help`

```text
usage: hermes mockreview [-h]
                         {setup,create,add-round,design,feedback,list,close,settings,housekeeping,owner,adopt,notify-test,publish,poll,serve} ...

mock-review CLI. First time? Run: hermes mockreview setup. `hermes mockreview settings` prints each setting and its source.

positional arguments:
  {setup,create,add-round,design,feedback,list,close,settings,housekeeping,owner,adopt,notify-test,publish,poll,serve}
    setup               onboard mock-review: secret, wake and notice routes,
                        hosting, autostart, a test review
    create              create a review (round 1 = --decisions or --prototype)
    add-round           add the next round (--decisions or --prototype)
    design              per-project design profiles the board wears (colours,
                        font, mock CSS, icon)
    feedback            print a round's feedback (JSON + markdown)
    list                list open reviews
    close               close a review (herenow: archive Site Data, delete the
                        site)
    settings            print the resolved settings and where each value came
                        from
    housekeeping        run the auto-close / prune pass once (the server runs
                        it hourly)
    owner               show who owns storage and wake-ups and whether a
                        create would pass preflight
    adopt               move one review from a private store into the watched
                        store (backup, collision checks, nothing lost)
    notify-test         send the wake-up payload to --to (testing only)
    publish             re-publish a herenow review
    poll                poll here.now Site Data once (what the server does
                        every poll_seconds)
    serve               run the board server in the foreground until Ctrl+C
                        (works with autostart off; exits 2 if the port is
                        taken)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `hermes mockreview setup --help`

```text
usage: hermes mockreview setup [-h] [-y] [--dry-run]
                               [--hosting {local,tailnet,lan,herenow}]
                               [--origin-platform NAME] [--port PORT]
                               [--webhook-route WEBHOOK_ROUTE]
                               [--no-autostart] [--plugin-dir PLUGIN_DIR]
                               [--skip-validate] [--skip-test-review]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -y, --yes             non-interactive: accept defaults and make the changes
  --dry-run             print the whole plan and change nothing
  --hosting {local,tailnet,lan,herenow}
                        how reviews are hosted (default: local)
  --origin-platform NAME
                        origin platform to create the wake and notice routes
                        for (repeatable); default: detected platforms
  --port PORT           board port (default: the port setting)
  --webhook-route WEBHOOK_ROUTE
                        route prefix (default: the webhook_route setting)
  --no-autostart        leave autostart off
  --plugin-dir PLUGIN_DIR
                        plugin dir to validate (default: the installed plugin
                        dir)
  --skip-validate       skip `hermes plugins validate`
  --skip-test-review    skip the test review
```

## `hermes mockreview create --help`

```text
usage: hermes mockreview create [-h] --title TITLE [--brief BRIEF]
                                --platform PLATFORM --chat-id CHAT_ID
                                [--thread THREAD]
                                [--mode {tailscale,tailnet,local,lan,herenow}]
                                [--decisions /abs/decisions.json]
                                [--prototype /abs/index.html]
                                [--design NAME|/abs/dir] [--allow-live-demo]
                                [--no-allow-live-demo]
                                [--devices desktop,tablet,mobile]
                                [--default-device {auto,desktop,tablet,mobile}]
                                [--default-theme {project,dark,light}]
                                [--theme-toggle] [--no-theme-toggle]
                                [--mobile-width PX] [--tablet-width PX]
                                [--pins] [--no-pins] [--require-note]
                                [--no-require-note] [--max-pins N] [--wake]
                                [--no-wake]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE
  --brief BRIEF
  --platform PLATFORM   origin platform, for example discord or telegram
  --chat-id CHAT_ID     origin chat identifier on that platform
  --thread THREAD       optional origin thread/topic identifier
  --mode {tailscale,tailnet,local,lan,herenow}
                        hosting (default: the default_host setting)
  --decisions /abs/decisions.json
                        a decision round: the board renders these decisions +
                        inline mocks itself (the default)
  --prototype /abs/index.html
                        a clickable prototype that fills the canvas under the
                        board bar (needs offer_live_demo or --allow-live-demo)
  --design NAME|/abs/dir
                        the project's design profile (saved name or a profile
                        dir); add-round inherits it
  --allow-live-demo     allow a --prototype round for this call
  --no-allow-live-demo  refuse a --prototype round for this call
  --wake                require a working wake route and wake Hermes on Send
                        (the default)
  --no-wake             a board nobody is woken by: no wake-route check, Send
                        stores feedback and notifies no one

per-review look (default: saved settings; stored in the review):
  --devices desktop,tablet,mobile
                        device widths offered on the board
  --default-device {auto,desktop,tablet,mobile}
  --default-theme {project,dark,light}
  --theme-toggle        show the theme toggle
  --no-theme-toggle     hide the theme toggle
  --mobile-width PX
  --tablet-width PX
  --pins                allow pins on mocks
  --no-pins             no pins
  --require-note        Send needs a note on every Change
  --no-require-note     Change marks need no note
  --max-pins N
```

## `hermes mockreview adopt --help`

```text
usage: hermes mockreview adopt [-h] --backup-dir BACKUP_DIR [--to TO]
                               [--dry-run] [--note NOTE]
                               source

positional arguments:
  source                absolute path of the review directory to move

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --backup-dir BACKUP_DIR
                        where the tar.gz backup of the source goes
  --to TO               absolute path of the watched store (default: the
                        running server's store, else <Hermes
                        home>/workspace/mock-reviews)
  --dry-run             validate and check collisions only; write nothing
  --note NOTE           wake note for a pending delivery (default: 'recovered
                        delivery, not a new request')
```
